format: pp.fullNames true, pp.universes false; explicit checked prototype types

types.SM.boundaryIndex: SM.boundaryIndex {n : ℕ} (g : ZMod n) (k : Fin n) : ZMod n
types.SM.boundaryWord: SM.boundaryWord {n : ℕ} (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (k : Fin n) : SM.Plane
types.SM.boundaryIndex_injective: SM.boundaryIndex_injective {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (g : ZMod n) : Function.Injective (SM.boundaryIndex g)
types.SM.boundaryWord_shift:
SM.boundaryWord_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g a : ZMod n) :
  SM.boundaryWord (SM.shift a P) (g - a) = SM.boundaryWord P g
types.SM.boundaryWord_first:
SM.boundaryWord_first {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 0 < n) :
  SM.boundaryWord P g ⟨0, hn⟩ = P (g + 1)
types.SM.boundaryWord_last:
SM.boundaryWord_last {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 0 < n) :
  SM.boundaryWord P g ⟨n - 1, ⋯⟩ = P g
types.SM.boundaryWord_leaf_edge:
SM.boundaryWord_leaf_edge {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n) :
  SM.boundaryWord P g ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ - SM.boundaryWord P g ⟨k, ⋯⟩ = SM.edge P (g + ↑(k + 1))
types.SM.BoundaryInterval.leaves_pos: SM.BoundaryInterval.leaves_pos {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : 0 < I.leaves
types.SM.IntervalComposition.parts_lt:
SM.IntervalComposition.parts_lt {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) :
  π.parts < n
types.SM.IntervalComposition.part:
SM.IntervalComposition.part {n : ℕ} {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (k : Fin π.parts) :

types.SM.IntervalComposition.single: SM.IntervalComposition.single {n : ℕ} (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : SM.IntervalComposition I

SM.rootData (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_hn : 3 ≤ n) :
